title: Layer 2 round 2 minor collector QE+security: untested pure halves and the env guard — milestone parse and count-strip, the glob length guard, empty-string HOME

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in a49206fe: in-module unit pins land for the acquisition's pure half (content-with-zero-parses is None never an empty success; open/closed lines with counts; the exact (N/M) strip against v1/2, (2024), and plain-name shapes) and for the extracted glob predicate glob_name_matches (the ab*ba/aba overlap guard, abutting exact-length match, ordinary content match). Empty or whitespace-only HOME now counts as unset in both the home-anchored guard and expand — no more fabricated cwd-relative resolution.
